tagline: Premier lifestyle office REIT focused on high-growth Sun Belt markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Occupancy rate reflects the operational health of the real estate portfolio and the ability to generate rental income, a key indicator for office REITs facing remote work challenges

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.description: Occupancy rate of the office portfolio

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital investments for development, redevelopment, and property improvements
kpis.description: Total capital expenditures including development, redevelopment, improvements, and leasing costs

kpis.name: Operating Leasing Costs
kpis.explanation: Leasing commissions and capitalized tenant improvements for operating properties
kpis.description: Leasing costs (commissions and tenant improvements) for operating properties
kpis.signal: Significant increase in leasing costs driven by strong leasing activity

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.description: Net cash provided by operating activities
kpis.signal: Stable operating cash flow with slight increase

kpis.name: Net Effective Rent (new leases)
kpis.explanation: Annual net rent per square foot after concessions and leasing costs for new leases
kpis.description: Net effective rent for executed new leases
kpis.signal: Decline in net effective rent reflecting a softer office market

kpis.name: Rent Growth - Renewals (straight-line basis)
kpis.explanation: Increase in straight-line annualized rent for lease renewals compared to prior leases
kpis.description: Straight-line annualized net rent growth for leases renewed during the year

kpis.name: Leasing Volume
kpis.explanation: Total square footage (new, renewals, expansions) leased during the period
kpis.description: Net leased square footage (new leases, renewals, and expansions)

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Geographic and sector concentration
risks.score_rationale: The portfolio is concentrated in a few Sun Belt markets with heavy reliance on Austin (36.1% of NOI) and specific sectors. Risks from localized or sector-specific slowdowns are significant.

risks.title: Economic downturn and tenant insolvency
risks.score_rationale: During a recession, leasing demand declines, delinquencies rise, and tenant viability is threatened. Direct impact on revenues and cash flow.

risks.title: Risk of declining office demand
risks.score_rationale: Remote work, co-working spaces, and reduced space requirements pose direct threats to the traditional office business model.

risks.title: Uninsured losses or underinsurance
risks.score_rationale: Extreme events (hurricanes, floods, pandemics) may result in significant losses with high deductibles (2-5%) and certain risks uninsurable.

risks.title: Climate change impacts
risks.score_rationale: Extreme weather events and sea level rise threaten real estate assets with direct and indirect effects (costs, regulation).

risks.title: Environmental compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: Strict regulatory obligations for site remediation and litigation risks are real, especially on older urban sites.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and data security
risks.score_rationale: Existing IT risks related to property and tenant data management represent an operational threat.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CUZ does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. There is no indication of its involvement in the AI field.
